acceptanceCriteria: Before checkpoint a Work Item may append declared scope only through Runtime and receives an append-only declaration receipt.
After checkpoint existing amendment and revalidation requirements remain fail-closed.
Unsupported Contract fields and identity or authority changes remain rejected.

A Runtime-authorized retry from finish_ready to checkpointed may refresh stale verification evidence without a second preflight, while an unbound stale snapshot remains rejected before process execution.
An explicit existing_active_successor recovery decision binds only a same-repository, same-base active successor without prior lineage, and refuses mismatched or already-bound successors.

The explicit existing_active_successor decision remains portable across same-version candidate binary rebuilds without relaxing runtime identity checks for retry, verification, authorization, or any other recovery mode.
The Runtime-generated WI-902 recovery decision binds the immutable archived predecessor to WI-903 without rewriting any WI-902 archive artifact.
The documentation status gate accepts the identity-continuous WI-902 to WI-936 to WI-937 recovery lineage only when its terminal successor has valid archive, verification, and close evidence.
A missing, malformed, cyclic, foreign, stale, or unclosed recovery lineage remains a fail-closed conditional-parity error.

For a Work Item with declared executable verification commands, default verification plans every declared command deterministically, preserves Cargo workspace partitioning, and reports an unparseable declaration before any project process is launched.
goal: 允许在尚未开始验证且 Contract 身份未变时安全追加缺失 scope；仍禁止变更 authority、base、已有验收、以及 checkpoint 后无再验证的 scope 扩张。
intent: 修复未 checkpoint 的 Work Item 无法补充前检必需 scope 的生命周期循环。
